symptom: A repository write returned an unknown transport outcome; blindly repeating the write could create duplicate or stacked changes.
lesson: Unknown write outcomes must be resolved by reading the branch head and target content before retrying. A tool error is not proof that the write did not occur.
guardrail: After any ambiguous GitHub write failure, read back branch HEAD and target diff first. Retry only if the intended mutation is absent; otherwise continue from the observed state.
